prompt:
Use case: clean educational photorealistic visual learning asset for the Hanzi 牙; subject ID tooth only.
Primary request: one vertical 1024x1792 photographic triptych containing exactly three independent horizontal landscape photographs stacked top to bottom, separated by two narrow straight white horizontal seams approximately 8 pixels thick near y=597 and y=1195. No outer border.
Subject/material: clean physical manufactured dental teaching models, ivory-white tooth replicas set in smooth pale pink synthetic gum bases, photographed on an uncluttered pale tabletop. These are unmistakably educational models, never a real person's mouth. No labels or printed numbers on any model.
Top photograph: close educational view of the front teeth on a dental model, with the central and lateral incisors clearly visible from the front and their straight biting edges distinguishable. Show a compact anterior model segment with its complete support base, not a real open mouth.
Middle photograph: close educational three-quarter view of the back teeth on a dental model, clearly showing premolars and the broad ridged chewing surfaces of molars. Show a compact posterior model segment with its complete support base, distinct from front incisors.
Bottom photograph: the complete curved row of teeth on a dental teaching model, an entire single U-shaped dental arch visible from a slightly elevated three-quarter front angle. Clearly show the front incisors and both sides extending to the back molars, all on one pink model gum base.
Composition/framing: exactly three standalone wide landscape product photographs in front-teeth, back-teeth, complete-row order. Center each model and keep its complete tooth group and support base at least 12 percent inside every panel edge. Clear clinical tabletop and softly blurred pale background; no hands, people, tools or distracting props.
Style/medium: authentic photorealistic photography of real-looking physical educational models, accurate recognizable incisor versus molar shapes, subtle matte plastic texture, believable manufactured material, soft natural daylight and realistic shadows. Not a diagram, illustration, cartoon or CGI scene.
Constraints: only clean educational dental models, never actual mouths, living gums or extracted real teeth. No blood, decay, injury, surgery, gore, dental drills or distress. Exactly three panels and two white seams. No writing, letters, numbers, captions, logos, brands, labels, watermark or decorative graphics.
reviewNotes: Inspected only the 300x525 JPEG preview. Top shows an anterior teaching-model segment with flat-edged front incisors and neighboring teeth; middle shows a posterior segment with broader molar chewing surfaces; bottom shows a complete U-shaped single tooth row with front and rear teeth. All are clean ivory tooth replicas on smooth pink manufactured gum bases on a pale tabletop, not real open mouths. Entire models remain inside the frames; middle base and bottom rear teeth have smaller vertical margins than requested 12 percent. No visible people, tools, blood, writing or watermark. Exact dental anatomy and tooth counts are not verified from this compact preview. Sharp measured white seam rows 569–581 and 1149–1160 in the 1024x1792 original; rounded centers 575 and 1155. Bottom panel is taller than the others.
